name: What to Expect During a High-End Finish Upgrade Project
description: First, we'll talk about what you need from your finishes. Is it durability, moisture resistance, or lightfastness? This helps us choose the right products that fit your lifestyle and home's demands.

step.name: Step 1: Define Performance Requirements
step.text: First, we'll talk about what you need from your finishes. Is it durability, moisture resistance, or lightfastness? This helps us choose the right products that fit your lifestyle and home's demands.

step.name: Step 2: Select Materials and Finish Systems
step.text: Next, we'll dive into material options – from specialty paints to unique plasters or veneers. We'll explore various systems that provide the look and performance you're after. This often includes discussions about what best suits the intended use of the space.

step.name: Step 3: Review Samples or Control Samples
step.text: This is where you get to see and feel the options. We'll provide samples for your review, and for complex projects, control samples ensure consistency across larger areas. This is crucial for verifying that the look and feel are exactly what you expect.

step.name: Step 4: Confirm Substrate and Preparation Requirements
step.text: No finish is better than its foundation. We'll assess the surfaces to be finished, ensuring they're properly prepared – smooth, clean, and ready to accept the new materials. This step often includes documentation of the specification to ensure clear guidelines for application.

step.name: Step 5: Procure Materials and Application
step.text: Once everything is approved, we'll procure the high-quality materials. Then, our skilled craftsmen will begin the application, adhering to precise techniques to ensure a flawless and consistent finish. Timing here can vary based on specialty material availability and required cure times.

step.name: Step 6: Inspect and Protect
step.text: Finally, we meticulously inspect the finished work to ensure it meets our high standards and your expectations. We’ll then protect the newly finished surfaces during any remaining construction or before handover. This protects your investment from accidental damage. A qualified finisher or designer is important when the upgrade involves complex staining, custom color matching, or strict appearance requirements. LineWork Development manages every phase of construction, from planning to final walkthrough, ensuring seamless execution and beautifully crafted living spaces.
